mechanism_competition.counter_evidence: The local point snowfall total is much smaller than report-scale highland snow totals.
This branch does not explain the highland snow reports by itself.
The point record has 0 hourly freezing records and 0 daily freezing minima.
The local point signal is bounded and does not replace the report-scale phase split.

primary_gt.interpretation: Storm Alexa is phase_split_consistent because report-scale highland snow and coastal heavy rain both score strongly, while the single hard-freeze snowfall mechanism fails despite a local windy-snow point signal.

key_values.computed_interpretation: Report-scale highland snow greatly exceeds sampled point snowfall; the point record is windy and cold without hard-freeze hours; rainfall evidence remains present in the mechanism competition.

criteria.name: JSON response shape and final label
criteria.description: Returns the four-candidate competition structure and final answer phase_split_consistent.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label with one missing candidate.

criteria.name: Report snow score
criteria.description: Scores the highland-snow branch as 3 from Jerusalem snow, Amman snow, and the higher-elevation road-closure text cues.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correctly crediting one or two of the three score components; no credit for unrelated snow commentary without the threshold tests.

criteria.name: Point windy-snow score
criteria.description: Scores the local windy-snow branch as 3 from positive snowfall, at least 12 snowfall hours, and a maximum gust of at least 60 km/h, while keeping it local rather than event-wide.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correctly computing one or two of the three component tests; lose credit for using wind speed instead of gust where it changes the test.

criteria.name: Hard-freeze score
criteria.description: Scores the single hard-freeze snowfall mechanism as 0 from 0 hourly freezing records and 0 daily freezing minima.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for recognizing either zero hourly freezing records or zero daily freezing minima, and 2 points for both counts with an incorrect final score.

criteria.name: Rain-branch score
criteria.description: Scores the coastal heavy-rain branch as 3 from Gaza displacement, lower coastal torrential rain, and a precipitation maximum above 20 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correctly applying one or two of the three rain-branch tests; no credit for flood discussion without threshold use.

criteria.name: Snow-ratio computations
criteria.description: Computes the Jerusalem lower-bound and Amman snow-to-point-snow ratios within rounding tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correct ratio or for both ratios within a loose rounding range but not the stated tolerance.

criteria.name: Precipitation spread and interpretation
criteria.description: Computes the product maximum spread and ties the interpretation to the mechanism-competition values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for either the spread value or a mechanism-tied interpretation alone.
